items.userAnswer: I get up at seven o'clock.
I was in office on last Sundays.
items.correctText: I was in the office last Sunday.
items.errorNote: 三处：①语法——in office 缺限定词，改为 in the office / in my office（与 play game 同源：可数名词不能裸用）；②语法——on last Sundays 里 last 前不加介词（与 at yesterday 同源）；③语法——「上周日」是单数 last Sunday，不是 last Sundays。
items.targetPoint: 介词 on / at + 时间状语限定词

mistakeCandidates.errorReason: 单数可数名词前必须有 a / the / my 之类的限定词
last / next / this 前不加介词；「上周日」用单数 last Sunday
